title: An anything-but-typical day at OpenText World 2026
summary: Join us at OpenText World 2026 in Orlando October 19-22 and find out just how much you can get accomplished in a single day.
body_markdown:
It’s day 1 of[OpenText World 2026](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/summary-1?environment=P2&i=&locale=en-US) in Orlando and you’re ready to go. After picking up your badge and fortifying yourself with a hearty breakfast, you head to the main stage at the Hyatt Regency Orlando’s Windermere ballroom to start a packed day of learning and exploration.


## Hear big ideas


First up at the general session is **OpenText CEO Ayman Antoun** , who talks about data in the AI era, describes OpenText’s role in the AI stack, and hosts a fireside chat with an OpenText client to share their perspective.


Next is **OpenText Executive Vice President, CIO, and CDO Shannon Bell** , who introduces the OpenText Global Command Centre and talks about how our products power it. OpenText partners IBM and Google share insights on driving value and enabling the agentic enterprise.


You wonder what OpenText World 2026 special guest speaker **[Reid Wiseman, NASA astronaut and the Commander of Artemis II,](https://blogs.opentext.com/artemis-ii-commander-reid-wiseman-to-headline-opentext-world-2026/)** will talk about at his keynote on Thursday afternoon, but realize that will have to wait since it’s time to…


## Validate your skills


You head to the certification room to take a[free exam](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:66191de3-1bf0-4ae6-af2d-a5be40c1359f?environment=P2&i=&locale=en-US) that proves your proficiency in OpenText products. These role-based exams certify your software knowledge and skills in real-world scenarios, giving you valuable credentials. You share your achievement on your social media profiles with OpenText certification digital badges—portable, verifiable credentials that showcase your abilities, then…


## Meet birds of a feather


After a quick stop at the expo floor for lunch, you head to an[industry client connect](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:325a48ef-903e-45c7-b8d6-82788e00e76e?environment=P2&i=&locale=en-US) . You join a table to talk with attendees about specific challenges in your industry and how to approach them. You have an interesting exchange with peers about how they’re using AI in their organizations, which reminds you to…


## Take a deep dive **with AI**


You head to a technical breakout session, where you learn how to structure information to maximize AI results. You stick around after the session to get some questions answered by OpenText product managers and developers when you realize you need to hurry to…


## Check out hands-on labs


You swing by the Innovation Lab to see new features of software you use and stop off at the Product Lab to walk through a few OpenText solutions you haven’t tried before. While test driving these products, you begin thinking about additional ways that OpenText software could help your business, but realize it’s time to…


## Join the conversation


The[Women in Tech reception](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:56e49aee-c337-47f8-b257-ae9e73b65435?environment=P2&i=&locale=en-US) , sponsored by EY and open to all OpenText World attendees, is about to begin. You make it just in time to be part of an interactive discussion with a panel of women who inspire, educate, mentor, and advocate for other women. You also get a chance to network with other OpenText World attendees…


## And that’s just day 1!


Day 2 has more keynotes, sessions, expo experiences, and of course the OpenText World party—an exclusive takeover of[Mango’s Tropical Cafe](https://orlando.mangos.com/) , one of Orlando’s most iconic entertainment venues. Day 3 features special guest speaker, Reid Wiseman and more education, innovation, and connection so you return home inspired and in the know.


## Just for partners


If you’re part of the OpenText partner ecosystem, your OpenText World experience starts with the[OpenText World Partner Summit](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2b143356-095a-4738-be3d-83623e6db512?environment=P2) on October 19. Designed exclusively for partners, the Summit brings you closer to the people, priorities and ideas shaping the future of the business.


At this event you dive into OpenText’s strategy and vision for partner-led growth, hear what’s new in AI and secure information management, and spot the solutions, routes to market, and selling plays that could help you win more business and create greater value for your clients.


Then you have the chance to put those ideas into action. You connect with OpenText leaders, sales teams, clients, and partners to strengthen existing relationships, spark new ones, and explore joint go-to-market plays that could open new client conversations, build pipeline, and create new routes to revenue.


The partner experience doesn’t stop when the Summit ends. Throughout OpenText World there are dedicated partner sessions, networking opportunities, hands-on experiences, and the Partner Expo Showcase Zone to give you even more ways to sharpen your expertise, discover solutions you can take to market, and find new ways to create value for your clients.


Don’t miss your chance to experience OpenText World 2026 live and in person October 19-22.


[Register today!](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/summary-1?environment=P2&i=&locale=en-US)
